notation.bank_factor: R = 1 + r * dt; r annual decimal and dt in years; R compounds across steps

assumptions: No dividends, fees, taxes, spread or default
Fractional shares, shorting, borrowing and lending at the same rate
Rebalancing at every tree step with self-financing strategy
Strict d < R < u; both real-world branches possible
distinctions: New two-step example is not a reproduction of the incompletely parameterized numerical tree on source pages 78-83
The symmetric 1 +/- sigma*sqrt(dt) moment construction is a short-step approximation, not exact finite-step GBM
Changing p alone leaves the fixed-tree replication price unchanged
Payoff, premium, liability and profit are distinct
